query:
UPDATE revisions r SET review_status = 'rejected', reviewed_by = $2, reviewed_at = now(),
                                review_note = $3
         FROM pages p
         WHERE r.id = $1 AND r.page_id = p.id AND p.wiki_id = $4
           AND r.author_id = $2 AND r.review_status = 'pending'
         RETURNING r.page_id
